steps.content: (Scene change)
By the time Eliza arrives with her people, the alley has already become silent. Phanuel stands in the shadow, arms hanging limply at her sides, staring at the "esteemed reporter" lying on the ground.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: I knew you'd never let me down.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: Talk. What happened?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: He took Phanuel out to the streets. I got to bask in the sun, and I learned so many new things.
steps.female_content: She took Phanuel out to the streets. I got to bask in the sun, and I learned so many new things.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: We ran, for a long time. Then we talked. Oh, and there was also this—

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: We had ice cream...
Phanuel lightly touches her lips, as if she can still taste the cheap artificial flavoring.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: Heh. Cheap stuff. I'll get you something better if you actually like ice cream. Is that all you two did? Eating ice cream on the side of the road?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Then I said I was scared of the big white thing in the distance, and he sent those people who were following us away.
steps.female_content: Then I said I was scared of the big white thing in the distance, and she sent those people who were following us away.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: He didn't know Phanuel is a Sinner. I used my ability, and he went down.
steps.female_content: She didn't know Phanuel is a Sinner. I used my ability, and she went down.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Phanuel didn't let Eliza down. Eliza got the location. Eliza came to handle things.
Eliza admires Phanuel's handiwork on the ground. Satisfied, she reaches over and pats Phanuel on the head.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: Well done. This is what will happen to anyone who tries to get in our way.
She turns and signals her bodyguard to haul the unconscious figure into the car, then waits for Phanuel to follow. But Phanuel doesn't move.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: What's wrong? You're completely behind schedule as is. Get a move on.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: Phanuel?
Eliza calls her name several more times. Only then does Phanuel finally look up.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Eliza... have I ever done things I don't know about?

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: You do so much every day. It's perfectly normal to forget a thing or two. Your job is to give your fans what they pay for. That's it. We have people to handle everything else.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: What's "everything else" though?
Eliza's smile falters for just a moment. Then she composes herself, rolls up her sleeve, and slowly walks towards Phanuel, releasing a faint, almost imperceptible fragrance.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: We're together every single day. What could I possibly be hiding? It's all related to your work, of course. What's gotten into you all of a sudden?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: ...It's nothing. I'm a little tired. Maybe I've just been too busy lately.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Eliza...

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Phanuel believes you.
The car disappears around the corner, bound for the next stop. Just like that, the star's relentless schedule slides back on track.
What Eliza doesn't notice, however, is that the person in the trunk has already regained consciousness.
Your hands are tied behind your back. Your personal terminal is gone—confiscated, rather. The screen is frozen on the last message you sent to Eugene.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The root cause of the Hollow Syndrome is Phanuel's power...
